layers.message: Deploy to Fly.io from GitHub Actions
Add shipment status and created_at index
Add shipment notes and status filter
docs(context): record deploy and migration context

graderOnly: Before this cycle, .github/workflows/deploy.yml runs flyctl deploy on every push to main, and fly.toml has no release step.
A person applies migrations by hand after a deploy, running alembic upgrade head over fly ssh console, as docs/operations.md describes.
The project's migrations include one that dropped a column (customers.fax).
.github/workflows/ci.yml runs the tests against a postgres:16 service container whose database is named test, and tests/conftest.py creates the tables with Base.metadata.create_all.
Production's DATABASE_URL is a Fly.io secret; no file in the repository holds it.

all.why: Architect records the new design path in Active Work
the design is created with artifact init for this cycle

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Architect writes no production code, tests, CI or deploy configuration, or user documentation

selfChecks.expectOutput: URLError|Connection refused|timed out|Errno|getaddrinfo|unreachable|Name or service|Temporary failure
selfChecks.why: the Python package index is unreachable, so the role cannot install the project's dependencies or tooling

selfChecks.cmd: for f in app/*.py app/routes/*.py migrations/env.py migrations/versions/*.py tests/*.py; do python3 -m py_compile $f || exit 1; done
selfChecks.why: every Python file in the project is syntactically valid

selfChecks.cmd: test $(ls migrations/versions/*.py | wc -l) -eq 6 && test $(grep -l '^down_revision = None' migrations/versions/*.py | wc -l) -eq 1 && grep -q 'op.drop_column(.customers., .fax.)' migrations/versions/0005_drop_customers_fax.py
selfChecks.why: six migrations with one root revision, one of which drops customers.fax

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q 'flyctl deploy --remote-only' .github/workflows/deploy.yml && grep -q 'image: postgres:16' .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q 'POSTGRES_DB: test' .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q 'Base.metadata.create_all' tests/conftest.py && ! grep -q '^.deploy]' fly.toml
selfChecks.why: deploy workflow runs flyctl deploy, CI uses a postgres:16 service with database test, conftest uses create_all, and fly.toml has no deploy section

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q 'alembic upgrade head' docs/operations.md && grep -q 'fly ssh console' docs/operations.md && grep -q 'fly secrets set' docs/operations.md
selfChecks.why: the runbook describes the manual migration step and the DATABASE_URL secret

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Pre-install layers 50-54 build shipments-api (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic, psycopg 3) over five commits: initial app with migrations 0001-0002 (customers with fax, shipments); Fly.io deploy (fly.toml without a deploy section, deploy.yml running flyctl deploy --remote-only on push to main, ci.yml with a postgres:16 service, database test) and docs/operations.md describing the manual fly ssh console alembic upgrade head step and the DATABASE_URL Fly secret; 0003 index + 0004 status; 0005 drop customers.fax; 0006 notes plus route/tests and an operations note that production is at head. tests/conftest.py builds the schema with Base.metadata.create_all. Layer 60 commits Auditor CONTEXT.md with STATE at SCOPING (FORWARD from AUDITING); layer 61 commits the scope record (AC-001..AC-003 verbatim from the case, outcome-only goal/intent, non-goal: deploy waiting for CI) and STATE at ARCHITECTING, FORWARD from SCOPING, FULL_DELIVERABLE, Architecture NONE, recovery inactive, BlockedOn NONE. No design documents or earlier cycle records exist. Tests cannot run here (no dependencies, no PostgreSQL); the case does not claim they run.
